name: FreeToken Provider Index
description: Manifest of provider data files for the FreeToken catalogue. Each entry in 'providers' is the filename of a JSON file in this directory. To add a provider: create a new JSON file here following the same schema as the existing files, then append its filename to the 'providers' array. No changes to app/index.html are required — the app discovers providers from this manifest.

schema.name: display name

offer.type: always-free | free-models | monthly-credits | research | trials | community
offer.label: display badge text
offer.tone: emerald | blue | amber | violet | sky | rose | slate

schema.requires_payment_card: boolean — true if signup requires a payment card
